summary_1line: After Sita returns to the earth, Rama grieves and angrily threatens the earth until Brahma reminds him of his divine nature and Sita’s eventual reunion with him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands trembling with tears, leaning on the sacrificial staff while threatening the Earth to return Sita who has just vanished into the ground.
The Earth closes after Sita descends while monkeys and sages cry out, and Rama stands stunned in grief before the assembly.
Brahma appears among the gathered gods before the grieving Rama, reminding him of his true identity as Vishnu.
